title: Microbiome and plasma metabolomics data in the Wenzhou Parkinson's disease cohort
author: HAIJUN He
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Collect plasma for LC‑MS
steps.instruction: Obtain plasma samples from each participant (140 Parkinson's disease patients and 72 healthy controls) and store them for subsequent liquid chromatography‑mass spectrometry (LC‑MS) metabolite analysis.

steps.title: Process LC‑MS data in MS‑DIAL
steps.instruction: Import the raw LC‑MS files into MS‑DIAL version 4, perform peak detection, deconvolution, and retention‑time alignment, then assign putative metabolite annotations by matching experimental MS/MS spectra against the Public MS/MS library (version unspecified) and cross‑validate the matches using the MassBank of North America (MoNA) and the Human Metabolome Database (HMDB).

substeps.instruction: Load raw files into MS‑DIAL v4
Run peak detection and deconvolution
Align retention times across samples
Match MS/MS spectra to Public MS/MS library
Cross‑validate matches with MoNA and HMDB

steps.title: Collect and freeze fecal samples
steps.instruction: Each participant provides either >1 g of fresh feces using a disposable sterile fecal sampling kit or >1 mL of fresh fecal solution in a tube containing 5 mL nucleic‑acid preservation solution; transfer the collected samples to a –80 °C storage environment within 2 hours of collection.

substeps.instruction: Collect feces (>1 g) or fecal solution (>1 mL) with preservation solution
Place samples on dry ice or refrigerated transport
Store at –80 °C within 2 h

steps.title: Extract fecal genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from the frozen fecal material using the cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB) method incorporated in the QIAGEN TIANamp DNA Stool Mini Kit (Cat# DP328, TIANGEN Biotech Co., Ltd., China) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Assess and dilute DNA
steps.instruction: Evaluate DNA concentration and purity by running a 1 % agarose gel electrophoresis; subsequently dilute the DNA to a final concentration of 1 ng/µL using sterile water.

substeps.instruction: Run 1 % agarose gel to check DNA quality
Measure concentration (e.g., by gel intensity or fluorometer)
Dilute DNA to 1 ng/µL with sterile water

steps.title: PCR amplify 16S V3‑V4 region
steps.instruction: Set up a PCR reaction containing 15 µL Phusion® High‑Fidelity PCR Master Mix (New England Biolabs), 2 µM each of primers 341F (CCTAYGGGRBGCASCAG) and 806R (GGACTACNNGGGTATCTAAT), 10 ng genomic DNA template, and 6 µL sterile water; thermocycle at 95 °C for 1 min, then 30 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, 50 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 30 s, followed by a final extension at 72 °C for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix with specified reagents and volumes
Program thermal cycler with the described profile

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Mix an equal volume of each PCR product with 1× loading buffer containing SYBR Green, load onto a 2 % agarose gel, and run electrophoresis to verify amplicon size.

substeps.instruction: Combine PCR product with SYBR Green loading buffer (1×)
Load onto 2 % agarose gel
Run gel and visualize bands

steps.title: Normalize and purify PCR products
steps.instruction: Normalize all PCR amplicons to the same concentration and purify them using the Qiagen Gel Extraction Kit (Qiagen, Germany) according to the kit instructions.

substeps.instruction: Quantify each amplicon and adjust to equal concentration
Perform gel extraction purification

steps.title: Prepare TruSeq PCR‑Free libraries
steps.instruction: Construct sequencing libraries from the purified amplicons using the Illumina TruSeq® DNA PCR‑Free Sample Preparation Kit with appropriate index codes, following the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: End‑repair and A‑tailing (if required by kit)
Adapter ligation with indexed adapters
Library cleanup steps as described

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Measure library concentration with a Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific) and evaluate fragment size distribution using an Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 system.

substeps.instruction: Quantify library with Qubit
Run Bioanalyzer chip to assess size profile

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq6000
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq6000 platform to generate 250 bp paired‑end reads (performed at Novogene, Beijing, China).

substeps.instruction: Load libraries onto NovaSeq flow cell
Run 250 bp paired‑end sequencing
